name: Fisheries Restoration Grant Program (FRGP)

funder.name: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

summary: Annual competitive grants for restoring, enhancing or protecting salmon and steelhead habitat in coastal California watersheds. Nonprofits, Tribes and public agencies can apply; the programme also covers environmental permitting for funded projects.

eligibility.rule: Project is not required for, or used as, regulatory mitigation
Project is not under enforcement action by a regulatory agency

documents: Detailed project and subcontractor budget spreadsheets
Status report on the applicant's status and past work

status.quote: The 2026 FRGP Proposal Solicitation Notice (PSN) is closed.

applicant_types.quote: Eligible applicants include state and local government agencies, public entities, Native American Indian Tribes, and nonprofit organizations.

geography.quote: FRGP administers a competitive grant program that has invested millions of dollars to support various projects throughout coastal California.

access.quote: All applications are accepted online through CDFW's WebGrants.

window.quote: The FRGP grant program operates on an annual grant cycle.

co_finance_required.quote: While cost share is not required, the amount of cost share does affect a proposal’s review score

eligibility.quote: Projects required for mitigation or used for mitigation (such as under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), California Endangered Species Act (CESA), Federal Endangered Species Act (ESA), National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA), California Forest Practices Act (FPA) or §404 of the Clean Water Act (CWA)) will not be considered for funding.
Projects under enforcement action by a regulatory agency are ineligible to apply to this PSN.

documents.quote: A completed Detailed Project Budget Spreadsheet and a Detailed Subcontractor Budget Spreadsheet to Supplementary Documents.
All proposals must include a Status Report explaining the applicant’s status and past work.

effort.quote: Proposals requesting more than $2,000,000 are required to submit a concept proposal to be eligible for funding under the full application.
Concept Proposal Phase Open: January 13 to March 2, 2026
Full Application Phase Open: May 4 to June 4, 2026
